# Speak with Holly

> Business English coaching for engineers and tech professionals, and team training for engineering/tech organizations, taught by Holly Richmond, a U.S.-licensed ESL teacher with 10+ years of experience.

Holly Richmond helps engineers and tech professionals communicate more confidently in English at work — in client meetings, design reviews, interviews, and everyday collaboration. Classes focus on practical speaking fluency built around each student's real job, not textbook grammar drills. She also works directly with engineering and tech companies to provide team-wide English training built from the team's own documents, designs, and meetings.

Based in Spain since 2021 (originally from Tulsa, Oklahoma, USA). All classes are 100% online via video call, so students and companies anywhere can join.

Best fit: intermediate to advanced students (B1-C1) who already have some English speaking experience and want to build fluency for real work situations. Not designed for absolute beginners.

## Services

- Individual classes: single class (€35/hr), 1x/week (€150/month), 2x/week (€280/month)
- Team training for companies: custom quote, 1:1 or group classes, one invoice/one contact billing, IRPF-withholding invoices (VAT-exempt as an education service under Spanish tax law)
